:::{#def-distribution-model}
#### Distribution model

A **distribution model** $\distmem$ for an outcome $\Outvar$ given a [covariate](#def-covariate) $\Predvar$
gives each covariate value $\predvar$
a probability distribution for $\Outvar$ given $\Predvar = \predvar$,
specified by its [cumulative distribution function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-cdf).
The [mean function](#def-mean-function) $\meanfnof{\distmem}$ of $\distmem$
maps each covariate value $\predvar$ to the mean of that distribution:

$$
\meanfnoff{\distmem}{\predvar}
\eqdef \Expfc{\distmem}{\Outvar \given \Predvar = \predvar}.
$$ {#eq-distribution-model-mean-function}

:::
